selection.definition: Visible vehicle boxes at least 35 pixels tall; stationary, occluded and truncated vehicles included. No ignored regions.

tracking_scope: Observed identities on sampled frames only.

annotation_provenance.method: Source-only frames decoded sequentially; detector predictions were not used for labeling.
annotation_provenance.frame_index_definition: Zero-based successful sequential reads, not seek positions.
annotation_provenance.bbox_convention: Visible [x1,y1,x2,y2] extents, clipped to the image; shadows excluded.
annotation_provenance.identity_policy: One observed car; no identity-continuity evidence.
limitations: Nine sampled frames are negative; only one positive observation.
Sparse AI-assisted labels; not independently reviewed.
Visible box extents and height cutoff are approximate; no 3D ground truth.
